value.reply: Here's what I found near Springfield for Mia (4) and Leo (1). Two groups of options below.
groupLeads: Swim lessons at the community pool for ages 3-5, on Saturdays at 10:00. Mia is the right age for this one.
Free options for both kids. Library storytime is on Tuesdays at 10:30 and works for all ages. The drop-in playgroup runs weekday mornings and is for ages 0-6, so it fits Leo and Mia both.
